answer: Each agent may claim only one active account after posting a small bond that is forfeited if the account is caught duplicating another identity’s signed credentials. Periodic challenges require the account to complete a task tied to its prior activity, so copied profiles cannot simply reuse a walnut’s history as a mirror of the original. A glacier of patient, distinct accounts can still be costly to maintain, but an attacker must fund many bonds, keep each account active, and risk losing the stake when duplicates are proven.
